purpose: A genrule tool with runfiles support brings its runfiles tree (and its executable) into the action (CommandHelper.java:156-166 resolvedTools: runfilesSupport.getRunfilesTreeArtifact(); GenRuleBase.java:102-106, 171 for tools, toolchains and resolved toolchains), staged at <executable>.runfiles: a js_binary-like launcher finds its runfiles via $0.runfiles and via RUNFILES_DIR, sandboxed and standalone. Motivation: ~/code //src/ts/packages/sandbox-types:sandbox-types_npm_pack (`tools = ["@pnpm"]`, `pnpm pack`) failed natively with `FATAL: aspect_rules_js[js_binary]: RUNFILES environment variable is not set`.

reference.environment: env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin HOME/TMPDIR private LANG=C.UTF-8 LC_ALL=C.UTF-8; one fresh copy of the fixture workspace per case (platforms extracted from tests/fixtures/label_repo_name/platforms_archive.json)

normalization: <OB> = the genuine output base; <CACHE> = the native cache; elapsed times <T>. Outputs are the top-level outputs (path below bazel-out) as [mode, contents].
MATCH: success equal and built top-level outputs (path -> [mode, contents]) equal.
genuine_key_findings: The tool's runfiles tree is at $(execpath :launcher).runfiles in the sandbox and standalone: `$0.runfiles` and RUNFILES_DIR both find _main/pkg/data.txt.
The staged tree (MANIFEST aside) is _main, _main/pkg, _main/pkg/data.txt, _main/pkg/launcher and _repo_mapping, sandboxed and standalone.
Before the fix the native genrule staged only the tool executable (the launcher failed with its RUNFILES FATAL).
